# Growech Solution

> Growech Solution (https://growech.site) is a premier AI automation studio and high-performance web engineering agency. We build autonomous AI workflows, enterprise WhatsApp Business API chatbots, and sub-second Next.js web applications for high-growth businesses in Pakistan, the UAE/Gulf, and global markets (United States & United Kingdom).

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [Autonomous AI & Workflow Automation](https://growech.site/services/ai-workflow-automation.html): Custom n8n, Make, and Python LLM agent workflows that eliminate manual operational bottlenecks and qualify inbound leads on autopilot.
- [Enterprise WhatsApp Business API](https://growech.site/services/whatsapp-business-api.html): Official Meta Cloud API integration, CRM synchronization, and automated 24/7 bilingual sales and patient/client intake chatbots.
- [Next.js Web Engineering](https://growech.site/services/nextjs-web-development.html): High-speed, edge-rendered web platforms built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS engineered for 100/100 Core Web Vitals and high conversion rates.
- [E-Commerce & Shopify Storefronts](https://growech.site/services/ecommerce-solutions.html): Custom Shopify themes, headless commerce, and automated WhatsApp 1-click checkout and COD confirmation.
- [Dedicated Remote Engineers](https://growech.site/services/remote-developers.html): Senior pre-vetted full-stack developers, Next.js engineers, and AI automation specialists from Pakistan with guaranteed timezone overlap.
- [Pakistan AI Agency & Headquarters](https://growech.site/locations/ai-automation-agency-pakistan.html): Local AI automation, Roman Urdu WhatsApp bots, and fast web development for Karachi, Lahore, and Islamabad.
- [Dubai & UAE Enterprise Agency](https://growech.site/locations/ai-automation-agency-dubai.html): High-ticket bilingual AI workflows for luxury real estate, aesthetic clinics, and B2B enterprises across Dubai & Abu Dhabi.
- [Niche Turnkey Architect Intake](https://growech.site/solutions/turnkey-architects.html): Filter high-ticket villa & commercial architectural inquiries automatically.
- [Dental & Aesthetic Clinic Booking](https://growech.site/solutions/dental-aesthetic-clinics.html): Automated 24/7 patient consultation booking and procedure screening.
- [Luxury Detailing & PPF Intake](https://growech.site/solutions/car-detailing-ppf.html): High-ticket ceramic and paint protection film intake qualification.

## Technical Architecture & Stack

### This Website (growech.site) Infrastructure:
- **Framework & Runtime**: React 18, Vite, TypeScript
- **Styling & Physics**: Tailwind CSS, Lenis Smooth Scroll, Lucide Icons
- **Deployment & Hosting**: Edge CDN, Pre-rendered Semantic HTML with JSON-LD Entity Graph

### Client Engineering Stack (What We Build for Clients):
- **Web Applications**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **AI & Workflow Automation**: n8n (self-hosted & cloud), Make.com, Python FastAPI, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini API, Supabase pgvector
- **Enterprise Messaging**: Official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API, Webhook Event Listeners, CRM sync (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive)
- **Database & Cloud**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Docker, Vercel, AWS

## Geographic Coverage & Locations Served

- **Pakistan (HQ)**: Karachi (Sindh), Lahore (Punjab), Islamabad (Federal Capital), Rawalpindi, Faisalabad.
- **Gulf / Middle East**: Dubai, Abu Dhabi (United Arab Emirates), Riyadh, Jeddah (Saudi Arabia), Doha (Qatar).
- **International / Global**: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia.
